entries.title: II Chronicles 17:3
segments: A succession of pious rulers is a great blessing to a people, and opens the way for permanent peace and prosperity.

entries.title: II Chronicles 17:7
segments:
To teach; teach the people the will of God. 
 
The teaching of the word and will of God to all the people, is the grand means of leading them to obey him, and thus securing his favor.

entries.title: II Chronicles 17:10
segments:
The fear of the Lord; a great dread, so that they did not dare to war against his servant. 
 
When a man's ways please the Lord, he maketh his enemies to be at peace with him; and they who seek Jehovah as their chief good, will not want any good thing.
